rule: Ashes may be packed in carry-on or checked-in baggage in a suitable, sealed urn or container that stays packed in the baggage during the flight; bring and show on request the death certificate, mortician certificate and a cremation certificate (name, where and when cremated, confirmation the container holds only ashes); no need to notify at booking but tell check-in staff at the airport; check requirements for the whole international journey. Domestic transport of ashes as cargo via Air New Zealand Cargo; international transport via a funeral director or freight forwarder.
